title: Leaderboard tab: remove Score column and restore Win % + Streak (all-time)

requirements.text: Update the Leaderboard tab (All-Time Rankings table) to remove the "Score" stat entirely (header and row values) so it is not displayed anywhere in the leaderboard table UI.

quotes: Also they added score for some reason which shouldnt be there

acceptanceCriteria: Leaderboard table no longer contains a column labeled "Score".
No score value is rendered in any leaderboard row.
No user-facing text references "Score" on the Leaderboard page.

requirements.text: Restore the "Win %" statistic in the all-time leaderboard table, calculated from all-time data only (wins / totalGames), and display it as a dedicated column for each player.
acceptanceCriteria: Win % is computed from the existing all-time stats returned by the backend (wins and totalGames) and does not depend on weekly/monthly timeframes.
When totalGames is 0, Win % displays as 0% (or equivalent non-error value) and the UI does not crash.

requirements.text: Restore the "Streak" statistic in the all-time leaderboard table and display it as a dedicated column for each player, using the existing all-time streak value returned by the backend leaderboard API.
acceptanceCriteria: Streak values displayed are sourced from the backend leaderboard stats (all-time) and update appropriately after recording/removing wins/losses.
The leaderboard page renders successfully for users with no games recorded (streak shown as 0 or equivalent).

requirements.text: Ensure the backend leaderboard API continues to provide all-time stats needed for the restored columns (wins, losses, totalGames, streak) and that leaderboard updates after recording/removing wins/losses reflect these fields without requiring weekly/monthly logic.
acceptanceCriteria: backend/main.mo getLeaderboard returns per-user stats that include wins, losses, totalGames, and streak (all-time).
After recording/removing a win/loss, the returned leaderboard stats reflect updated wins/losses/totalGames/streak for the caller.
No weekly/monthly timeframe parameters or filtering are reintroduced.

constraints: Backend must remain a single-actor Motoko canister (all logic in backend/main.mo).
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Do not reintroduce weekly or monthly leaderboard views, filters, or timeframe toggles.
Do not add any new leaderboard statistics beyond Win %, Streak, and the existing wins/losses/games columns.
Do not change the leaderboard ranking methodology unless required to remove the Score display (sorting may remain as-is).
